purpose: Govern which publishers may supply content for the Reading Library production import pipeline. This manifest does not itself grant rights, approve an article, create an import approval, or replace article-level validation.

runtimeEnforcement.note: The production importer currently loads Phase 3.5 source-policy fixtures. This manifest is the governing whitelist record but is not yet consumed by runtime code; existing validation, approval, duplicate, provenance, and transaction gates remain unchanged.

conditionsForAddingSource: Record clear, applicable rights evidence from an authoritative source; mere Internet availability, accessibility, or a source being widely used is not evidence of reuse permission.
Assess whether the evidence covers the intended full-text reuse and the relevant jurisdiction; retain any geographic, term, attribution, non-commercial, or other limits.

Review article-level author/byline, body, embedded quotations, image/media credits, and other third-party material independently. Exclude assets or content without rights evidence covering the intended reuse.
Record rights evidence and required attribution in intake/package provenance. Never assert rightsStatus=verified unless the existing rights validator accepts evidence that supports that status.

Register or update the applicable production source-policy fixture through an explicitly reviewed policy change before attempting import; a whitelist entry alone does not override a stricter existing runtime policy.
Pass all existing intake, package, human approval, duplicate, provenance, and atomic import gates.
globalRules.unresolvedRightsOutcome: SKIP; do not persist the full text or create an approved package or import approval.
globalRules.prohibitedRightsOutcome: REJECT or SKIP according to the existing pipeline outcome; do not persist prohibited full text.

sources.allowedReuse: A qualifying VOA-produced Learning English article may be considered for full-text reuse under the existing conditional grant; this is not blanket approval for every item or asset.
conditions: The canonical article URL is on the official learningenglish.voanews.com host.
The article has a byline or author credit identifying VOA Learning English or VOA as the producer.
The full text is obtained from the official article page and inspected for third-party copyright notices, agency reporting/credits, and other material not covered by the VOA grant.

Do not reuse AP, Reuters, AFP, or other third-party copyrighted text or assets unless separate evidence establishes permission for the intended reuse. Exclude unverified images/media; text-only import is permitted when the article text independently qualifies.
Record the official policy URL and captured policy wording as rights evidence.
Set attributionRequired=true and preserve the policy credit: Credit to learningenglish.voanews.com.
Run the existing Phase 3.5 conditional rights validator; do not treat this manifest entry as authorization to set rightsStatus=verified manually.
Create a valid approved package and separate hash-bound library import approval, then pass the official importer duplicate, provenance, and transaction checks.
sources.excludedContent: Any item or asset identified as third-party or otherwise not established as VOA-produced and reusable is excluded unless separate item/asset-level permission evidence covers the intended reuse.

sources.allowedReuse: A NOAA-authored Ocean Service explainer page whose own text carries a NOAA author credit, a citation date and no copyright, third-party or restriction notice may be considered for full-text reuse under the official NOS website disclaimer. This is not blanket approval for every item, every NOS page, or any asset.
conditions: The canonical article URL is on the official oceanservice.noaa.gov host.
The page itself carries an explicit NOAA author credit and a readable citation ('Last updated') date; an item without a NOAA credit is excluded.

The official disclaimer permission is qualified by 'unless specifically noted otherwise', so each page is inspected individually for copyright, third-party credit, courtesy/licence or other restriction notices; any such notice excludes the item.

Do not reuse third-party or partner material credited to other agencies, organisations or individuals. Exclude unverified images/media; text-only import is permitted when the article text independently qualifies.
Record the official disclaimer URL and its captured wording as rights evidence, with a public-domain rights basis.
Set attributionRequired=true and preserve the credit: NOAA Ocean Service, oceanservice.noaa.gov.
Set imageReference to null unless independent asset-level rights evidence covers the intended reuse; no NOAA image is imported in this batch.
Run the existing Phase 3.5 and Phase 3.7 validators; do not treat this manifest entry as authorization to bypass a gate.
Create a valid approved package and separate hash-bound library import approval, then pass the official importer duplicate, provenance, and transaction checks.
sources.excludedContent: Any item or asset identified as third-party, separately copyrighted, courtesy/licensed, or otherwise not established as NOAA-authored public information is excluded. Agency seals, logos and agency identification are excluded entirely.

sources.allowedReuse: A NASA-authored science explainer whose text carries NASA page provenance, a readable citation date and no third-party credit, courtesy/licence notice, syndicated or contributed content may be considered for full-text reuse for educational and informational purposes under NASA's official Images and Media Usage Guidelines. This is not blanket approval for every NASA item, every NASA page, or any image or identifier.
conditions: The canonical article URL is on an official NASA host (nasa.gov or a subdomain).
Use is educational or informational, factual, and does not imply NASA endorsement.
NASA is acknowledged as the source: set attributionRequired=true with a NASA credit line.

Third-party copyright-protected material is excluded. NASA states its use of such material conveys no rights to others, so any page whose text carries a third-party credit, courtesy line, licence note, syndicated or contributed/guest content or a news-agency credit is skipped.
A credit naming a partner agency or non-NASA provider (ESA, CSA, STScI, a university, a commercial provider) excludes the item.
Each item must carry NASA page provenance (page editor or responsible NASA official) and a readable 'Page Last Updated' date.
Set imageReference to null. The NASA Insignia, Logotype and NASA identifiers are expressly not in the public domain and are never reused.
Topic hub and index pages are excluded; a page that is mostly in-body links is navigation, not an article.
Run the existing Phase 3.5 and Phase 3.7 validators; this manifest entry does not authorize bypassing any gate.
Create a valid approved package and separate hash-bound library import approval, then pass the official importer duplicate, provenance and transaction checks.
sources.excludedContent: Any item carrying third-party, separately copyrighted, courtesy/licensed, syndicated, contributed or guest material is excluded, as are all NASA images, insignia, logotypes and identifiers.
